description: Registry mapping voice IDs to CRI cue sheets and cue names; the central lookup for battle, story, menu, sequencer and customization voice playback.

Id.technical: FName primary key. Producers pass this ID from BattleTalk.Id_Voice, CharacterVoiceGroup/VoiceGroup arrays, story-demo/short-story/DLC voice rows, custom-voice samples, unique-pair rows and PlayVoice candidate arrays. Finders walk DTM.VoiceDataTables (+0x740), reject None when requested, and return the first typed row. Export spells it ID.

CueSheetName.simple: Name of the loaded CRI Atom cue sheet containing the voice.
CueSheetName.technical: FString. Passed to FindLoadedCueSheet before 2D/3D voice playback; a missing loaded sheet returns no handle. Preload collectors from battle talk, story voice tables and battle phases read this same string to request sheets. No empty-sheet fallback exists in PlayVoice/PlayVoice3D.

CueName.simple: CRI cue name for the spoken line.
CueName.technical: FString. Set on the Atom voice player through GetLocalizedVoiceCueName, which appends "_En" when GameSoundManager.bAppendEnVoiceSuffix is set; English variants therefore exist as separate Voice rows with _En cue names. The same unlocalized CueName is used as a VoiceVolumeDataTable key (FName(CueName), default 1.0) for per-line volume, and sequencer volume tracks match active voice players by this name.

notes: Loaded as a DataTable primary asset named VoiceDataTable into DTM.VoiceDataTables (+0x740).

This is the leaf audio table: nearly every other voice-related table stores an Id that resolves here; playback then consults VoiceVolumeDataTable using CueName and a loaded cue sheet named by CueSheetName.
Cue names carry an explicit _En variant in the exported rows and the sound manager can also append the suffix at runtime; both mechanisms were observed and should not be conflated.
The companion export is large but partial; no claim is made about all retail rows or Blueprint-only consumers. Sources are reconstructed retail C++ with retail RVAs recorded inline.

usages.detail: PlayVoiceById resolves a row and plays its cue sheet/cue on a voice slot.
PlayVoice checks that the row cue sheet is loaded, applies localization and per-cue volume.
Queues Voice rows resolved from PlayVoice/Group IDs.
Battle-talk lines play their Id_Voice on the speaker slot.
Sequencer 2D/3D voice playback resolves rows by SoundId.
Story message commands resolve Voice rows for delayed playback.
Sequencer volume track matches active players by row CueName.
